'''Magras''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At one point in [[3642 BBY]], Magras captured [[Broga Masrii]], the last remaining member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-allied [[Three Families]], but was soon defeated by a Republic ally and Broga was saved.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Magras appears as an enemy in the Republic faction's storyline on Quesh in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was also originally planned to be involved "The Joy of the Hunt," an Imperial mission that would have involved a character named Lord [[Tragest]], but the mission was cut before the game's release.<ref name="FQN">Internal files from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the fully-qualified name of one NPC instance of Lord Magras: ''location.war_world.mob.bronze.imperial.the_joy_of_the_hunt.lord_magras''</ref>
